title: AssistantDiscussionAdapter
description: The finite vocabularies Epic #443 pins for the AI Discussion UI Adapter (Issue #444, Phase 1). `docs/01-specifications/capabilities/ai-discussion-adapter.md` §1 is the canonical contract; `docs/01-specifications/capabilities/assistant-discussion.md` §1/§2 are the canonical contract for the underlying thread/proposal persistence these vocabularies describe (unchanged by this Epic). This schema does not describe a new persisted row shape -- Phase 1 adds no database table -- it exists so `tests/test_discussion_contract_parity.py` has one machine-checkable source alongside the server `Literal`s (`app/models.py`) and the Dashboard unions (`src/api/types.ts`) for every enum this Epic's registry introduces or touches. Each `$defs` entry below is referenced elsewhere as `#/$defs/<name>` rather than restated.

discussion_scope.description: docs/01-specifications/capabilities/assistant-discussion.md §1.1. Fixed per target_kind (never chosen by the caller) via the scope -> target_kind first-match table `app/discussion_adapters.py`'s registry derives `SCOPE_TARGET_KINDS` from.

discussion_target_kind.description: docs/01-specifications/capabilities/ai-discussion-adapter.md §1.1/§1.2/§4.1. One `DiscussionAdapter` per value, registered in `app/discussion_adapters.DISCUSSION_ADAPTERS` -- an unregistered value is refused fail-closed (422 discussion_target_kind_unregistered) rather than silently degrading. Phase 1 (#444) covered the 9 kinds Epic #436 (#438) already shipped; Issue #453 (Phase 4, #447's follow-up) adds the Vision-to-Feature 8 kinds below, additively -- each resolves against an EXISTING owning module's stable identity (purpose_element/purpose_relation -> app/purpose_chain.py, stakeholder/stakeholder_need -> app/stakeholder_network.py, product_objective/product_milestone/product_gap -> app/product_objective.py, product_feature -> app/product_feature.py), never a new id scheme.

discussion_target_state.description: docs/01-specifications/capabilities/assistant-discussion.md §1.3. Derived at read time from the captured digest vs. the target's current canonical digest -- never a stored column, so an edited target cannot keep reporting a stale answer as current.

discussion_capability.description: docs/01-specifications/capabilities/ai-discussion-adapter.md §1.3. Derived from what a DiscussionAdapter actually declares (`fields`/`relations`/`children`/`ui_draft_forms`/`joint_understanding_bridge`) -- never a stored column or a second constant, so a capability can never drift from the adapter that is supposed to back it. Phase 1 derived only `read_canonical`/`propose_fields`/`propose_relations` true (every `ui_draft_forms`/`children` was empty and `joint_understanding_bridge` false); Phases 2/3/5 (#445/#452/#454) populate `ui_draft_forms` and one adapter's `children`, and `promote_joint_understanding` remains unreachable until #449 -- this enum itself does not widen for any of that.

discussion_proposal_item_kind.description: docs/01-specifications/capabilities/assistant-discussion.md §2.3. Unchanged by Epic #443 Phase 1 -- included here so the parity test can check it alongside the adapter vocabularies above in one place.

discussion_proposal_item_status.description: docs/01-specifications/capabilities/assistant-discussion.md §2.3. The item's OWN persisted lifecycle -- separate from `discussion_proposal_item_eligibility`, which is derived at read time and never stored (§2.2).

discussion_proposal_item_eligibility.description: docs/01-specifications/capabilities/assistant-discussion.md §2.2's first-match order: forbidden -> stale -> conflict -> appliable. Derived at read time from the target's CURRENT canonical digest and the item's own status/address, never stored.

ui_draft_state.description: docs/01-specifications/capabilities/ai-discussion-adapter.md §2.6 (Issue #445, Epic #443 Phase 2). `not_provided` (client sent none) and `unreadable` (a form IS open for this target but the client could not read it, self-reported via `UiDraftContextIn.readable`) are deliberately distinct answers: an assistant that reports the former when the latter is true is describing a screen the developer is not looking at. Recorded on the USER turn only (`assistant_discussion_turn.ui_draft_state`); `NULL` on a pre-#445 row is a FOURTH, distinct meaning ('this server could not have recorded it') that this enum does not cover.

discussion_operation_result.description: docs/01-specifications/capabilities/ai-discussion-adapter.md §1.3/§1.7/§9 (Issue #456). What a discussion-adapter READ operation (canonical context gathering, prefill readiness, ...) reports about ITSELF, kept in a field separate from the facts/capabilities it accompanies and separate from `discussion_target_state` (freshness). First-match: `unsupported` (no adapter/handler registered for this operation -- a structural gap in the current catalog), `unavailable` (a registered handler exists but this specific attempt failed), `not_applicable` (this kind of target can never carry this operation, independent of registration state). A deleted/inaccessible target stays on the existing resolver/404 contract rather than being reclassified into this vocabulary.

discussion_context_completeness.description: docs/01-specifications/capabilities/ai-discussion-adapter.md §9.1/§9.2 (Issue #458, DD-CTX-02). `unknown` means the walk was cut off before even the candidate COUNT could be established -- never a guessed lower bound reported as `partial`.

discussion_context_stop_reason.description: docs/01-specifications/capabilities/ai-discussion-adapter.md §9.1 (Issue #458). Why one section's coverage stopped short of `complete`; `complete` doubles as "nothing stopped it".

discussion_context_resolution.description: docs/01-specifications/capabilities/ai-discussion-adapter.md §9.1 (Issue #458). One bundle entry's own resolution -- mirrors `discussion_adapters.ResolvedTarget.resolution` exactly.

discussion_context_deep_link_state.description: docs/01-specifications/capabilities/ai-discussion-adapter.md §9.1 (Issue #458). Whether a bundle source's `deep_link` both exists and selects the exact entity (`selected`), only opens the owning screen (`screen_only`), or does not exist (`unavailable`).

discussion_context_next_action_kind.description: docs/01-specifications/capabilities/ai-discussion-adapter.md §8/§9.1 (Issue #458). The ONLY action a context bundle itself carries is "fetch more context" -- never a domain action; #459 owns the discussion's own main operation.

discussion_context_audit_consumer_kind.description: docs/01-specifications/capabilities/ai-discussion-adapter.md §9.3 (Issue #458). The durable audit table's finite `consumer_kind` -- which kind of durable row a bundle's dependency manifest backed. Mirrors `app/discussion_context_bundle.CONTEXT_AUDIT_CONSUMER_KINDS` exactly.
